Maya (PM): Quick sync — AcmeCorp requested a private pilot with strict P95 latency <=300ms and KMS-backed keys. Need cross-team sequencing: runtime changes, infra slots, and security signoff. Who can own the orchestration this week?
Kevin (Eng-runtime): I can own runtime pieces. Need model variant decision (fp16 vs int8/4bit) and sample prompts to validate perf. Also propose a 15m prewarm window.
Anika (Infra): Infra can provision a dedicated GPU pool but we need committed window for reserved capacity. What's the expected steady concurrency for the pilot? That drives slot counts and vnet layout.
Sam (Product Ops): Customer expectation: burst up to 200 qps, but pilot can start at 50 qps. They want canary + automatic fallback to hosted if capacity is hit. Also ask for rolled SLA for errors.
Leo (Security): KMS + audit logs required. For private we can do cloud KMS short-term; HSM onboarding will be ~4 weeks and needs compliance approval. Any chance to use cloud KMS for the 2-week pilot?
Maya (PM): Short-term plan: cloud KMS + audit logs for pilot, target 2-week canary. Long-term: HSM path. We'll aim for security signoff after the pilot and a follow-up HSM timeline.
Kevin (Eng-runtime): Runtime worklist (rough):
- enable prefix KV cache for common prompts
- add quantized model variant (4-bit) with fallback to fp16
- expose per-route batch/window tuning
Estimate: 5 dev-days + 2 test-days. Need perf targets and a small prompt corpus.
Anika (Infra): Infra estimate: ~10 GPU-days to provision pool, networking (VPC peering), KMS config, and routing policy. Also need a dedicated monitoring hop for console retention. Please confirm expected token sizes.
Sam (Product Ops): Sample prompt suite: avg request ~512 tokens in + 512 tokens out -> ~1024 tokens/request. For pilot we'll use qps=50 as baseline.
Kevin (Eng-runtime): Quick sizing calc we used locally:
```
# rough estimate
qps = 50
avg_tokens = 1024
tokens_per_second = qps * avg_tokens
gpu_throughput = 2000  # tokens/sec per GPU (int8-ish)
gpus_needed = ceil(tokens_per_second / gpu_throughput)
```
For qps=50, avg_tokens=1024 => tps=51200 => gpus_needed ~= 26. This is conservative; with KV cache and batching we expect ~30-40% reduction.
Anika (Infra): That raw number seems high; with batching and prefix cache we can target gpus_needed ~15 for pilot. I'll do a sizing doc and attach to a ticket. Also need a CIDR & peering checklist from networking.
Leo (Security): Also add end-to-end trace sampling and retention for the pilot. We'll want 30-day logs but redact PII. Need an owner for the redaction rules.
Maya (PM): Action items:
- Kevin: produce perf run with sample prompts + canary config (due in 3 business days).
- Anika: draft infra sizing + networking checklist + provisional cost estimate (5 business days).
- Leo: outline KMS/HSM plan and minimal audit checklist for pilot (3 business days).
- Sam: consolidate customer expectations and confirm pilot qps and success criteria (SLA, error budget).
@deploy-bot: can you make a ticket for this pilot and link the sizing doc?
deploy-bot: Created ticket RF-472: "acmecorp-private-pilot-scope" and attached initial template.
Kevin (Eng-runtime): I'll paste a short canary config once perf runs finish. Might ask for a short model freeze window during canary.
Sam (Product Ops): If we do a model freeze, coordinate with customer-facing docs and rollback plan. Also, decide metric for rollback (P95 latency > 350ms OR error rate > 1%).
Anika (Infra): I'll schedule a 30-min rendezvous tomorrow 10:00 to go over network/CIDR.
Maya (PM): Good. I'll set up daily 10:00 sync for the pilot week and update the roadmap ticket. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Kevin (Eng-runtime): Ack.
Leo (Security): Ack, will draft the minimal checklist.
Sam (Product Ops): I'll ping legal re: contract addendum for pilot SLA.
Maya (PM): Leaving this thread open for updates.
